recipes.title: Healthy Lime-Marinated Fish Ceviche
recipes.description: A refreshing and protein-packed coastal Mexican dish. Fresh white fish is 'cooked' in acidic lime juice and tossed with crisp garden vegetables for a vibrant, low-calorie appetizer.

ingredients.displayName: Fresh white fish (Cod or Tilapia), diced

instructions: Place the diced fish in a glass bowl and pour the lime juice over it. Ensure the fish is completely submerged. Cover and refrigerate for 20-30 minutes until the fish turns opaque.
In a separate bowl, combine the tomatoes, red onion, cilantro, and jalapeño.
Drain the excess lime juice from the fish. Gently fold the fish into the vegetable mixture.
Just before serving, fold in the diced avocado to keep it from mashing.
Season with a pinch of sea salt and serve with baked tortilla chips or lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Roasted Cauliflower & Black Bean Tacos
recipes.description: A hearty and nutritious vegetarian taco. Cauliflower florets are roasted until caramelized and paired with protein-rich black beans and a zesty cabbage slaw.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Toss cauliflower florets with cumin, chili powder, and a teaspoon of olive oil.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes until edges are browned and tender.
Warm the black beans in a small pot with a splash of water.
Warm the tortillas on a dry skillet for 30 seconds per side.
Assemble tacos by placing a spoonful of beans, roasted cauliflower, and a handful of cabbage slaw in each tortilla. Top with a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Grilled Shrimp & Mango Salsa Salad
recipes.description: A tropical and high-protein salad. Char-grilled shrimp are served over a bed of mixed greens and topped with a sweet and spicy mango-lime salsa.
instructions: Make the salsa: Combine diced mango, lime juice, a tablespoon of cilantro, and honey in a small bowl. Let sit to meld flavors.
Grill the shrimp for 2-3 minutes per side over high heat until pink and slightly charred.
Place salad greens in two large bowls. Top with the grilled shrimp and a generous portion of mango salsa.
Drizzle with the remaining salsa juices as a dressing.

recipes.title: Lite Chicken Pozole Verde
recipes.description: A comforting green chili and hominy stew. This version uses lean chicken breast and a blended sauce of fresh tomatillos and roasted poblanos.
instructions: Boil chicken in 6 cups of water with an onion until cooked. Shred the chicken and keep the broth.
Boil tomatillos and the poblano until soft. Blend with cilantro and a garlic clove to make the salsa verde.
Stir the salsa verde and hominy into the chicken broth. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the shredded chicken back to the pot. Serve hot, topped with sliced radishes and cabbage.

recipes.title: Mexican Quinoa Power Bowl
recipes.description: A nutrient-dense grain bowl inspired by Mexican flavors. Quinoa is paired with black beans, corn, and avocado for a high-fiber, energizing lunch.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package directions. Fluff with a fork.
In a large bowl, layer the quinoa, black beans, and corn.
Top with fresh salsa, diced avocado, and a squeeze of lime juice. Toss before eating.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Lettuce Wraps
recipes.description: A low-carb alternative to traditional tacos. Seasoned ground turkey is served in crisp butter lettuce leaves for a high-protein, light dinner.
instructions: Brown the turkey and onion in a non-stick skillet until cooked through.
Stir in the taco seasoning and a splash of water. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Spoon the turkey mixture into the lettuce leaves and top with your favorite healthy toppings.

recipes.title: Grilled Corn (Elote Lite)
recipes.description: A healthier version of Mexican street corn. We use plain Greek yogurt instead of mayonnaise for a creamy coating that’s lower in fat but high in flavor.
instructions: Grill corn on the cob until slightly charred on all sides.
Brush each cob with a thin layer of Greek yogurt.
Sprinkle with chili powder and a pinch of salt. Serve with lime wedges.

recipes.title: Mexican Squash & Tomato Stew
recipes.description: A traditional vegetarian stew (Calabacitas). Tender Mexican squash is simmered with tomatoes, corn, and a hint of onion for a light, fiber-rich meal.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in a pot. Add the squash and tomatoes.
Simmer covered for 15 minutes until the squash is tender.
Stir in the corn and cook for 5 more minutes. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Watermelon & Jicama Salad
recipes.description: A crisp and hydrating Mexican summer salad. The sweetness of watermelon is contrasted with the crunch of jicama and a zing of lime and chili.
instructions: Combine watermelon and jicama cubes in a large bowl.
Drizzle with fresh lime juice and sprinkle with chili powder.
Toss gently and serve chilled as a refreshing side or snack.

recipes.title: Healthy Black Bean Tostadas
recipes.description: A quick and high-fiber lunch. Baked corn tortillas are topped with a savory black bean mash and plenty of fresh, crisp lettuce.
instructions: Spread a thick layer of warm black bean mash over each crisp tortilla.
Top with a generous amount of shredded lettuce, fresh salsa, and a few slices of radish.

recipes.title: Pico de Gallo Chicken Breast
recipes.description: A simple and clean protein dish. Lean chicken breast is grilled and topped with an abundance of fresh, zesty Pico de Gallo salsa.
instructions: Grill the chicken breasts until cooked through (165°F).
Mix tomatoes, onion, cilantro, and lime to make the fresh Pico de Gallo.
Top the hot chicken with a mountain of the fresh salsa and serve with a side of greens.

recipes.title: Roasted Poblano Soup
recipes.description: A silky and smoky green soup. Roasted poblano peppers are blended with a touch of yogurt for a creamy texture that is low in fat.
instructions: Roast poblanos under a broiler until skin is blackened. Peel and remove seeds.
Blend the peppers with the vegetable broth until completely smooth.
Heat the soup in a pot, then stir in the yogurt just before serving. Do not boil.

recipes.title: Mexican Scrambled Eggs (Huevos a la Mexicana)
recipes.description: A high-protein breakfast that reflects the colors of the Mexican flag. Scrambled eggs are tossed with sautéed tomatoes, onions, and green chilies.
instructions: Sauté the onion and chili in a non-stick pan for 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and cook until they release their juices.
Pour in the whisked eggs and scramble until set. Serve with a slice of whole wheat toast.

recipes.title: Grilled Sea Bass with Lime & Cilantro
recipes.description: A simple and elegant seafood dish. Sea bass is grilled with a bright citrus marinade and served with a side of roasted vegetables.
instructions: Marinate the fish in lime juice and cilantro for 10 minutes.
Grill for 5-6 minutes per side until the fish is opaque and flaky.

recipes.title: Healthy Guacamole with Jicama
recipes.description: A fiber-rich take on the classic dip. We use ripe avocados mixed with diced jicama for a satisfying crunch and added volume without extra fat.
instructions: Mash the avocados with the lime juice until mostly smooth.
Stir in the diced jicama, onion, and cilantro. Season with sea salt.

recipes.title: Chipotle Turkey Meatballs
recipes.description: Lean turkey meatballs with a smoky Mexican twist. Simmered in a spicy chipotle tomato sauce for a high-protein, bold meal.
instructions: Form turkey into small meatballs and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes.
Simmer tomato puree with chipotle in a pan. Add the meatballs and toss to coat.

recipes.title: Nopales (Cactus) and Tomato Salad
recipes.description: A uniquely Mexican salad featuring prickly pear cactus pads. High in fiber and extremely refreshing when paired with ripe tomatoes and lime.
instructions: Toss diced cactus with tomatoes and onions in a bowl.
Add fresh cilantro, lime juice, and a pinch of salt. Serve as a cooling side dish.

recipes.title: Lean Shredded Beef Tacos
recipes.description: Traditional shredded beef made with extra lean roast. Slow-cooked with Mexican spices until it pulls apart perfectly, served in corn tortillas.
instructions: Slow cook the beef with cumin, garlic, and 1 cup of water until it can be easily shredded with two forks.
Serve the shredded beef in warm corn tortillas with plenty of fresh cabbage slaw.

recipes.title: Pineapple Chili Salsa
recipes.description: A sweet and spicy salsa that’s perfect over grilled fish or chicken. Fresh pineapple provides a tropical sweetness that pairs beautifully with chili.
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a bowl. Let sit for 15 minutes before serving to allow the flavors to combine.

recipes.title: Mexican Tomato & Lime Soup
recipes.description: A light and zesty tomato soup. The acidity of the lime and the heat of the chili make this a refreshing and low-calorie lunch option.
instructions: Simmer tomatoes and broth with a pinch of cumin for 20 minutes. Stir in fresh lime juice before serving.

recipes.title: Zucchini Quesadillas
recipes.description: A healthier take on quesadillas. We use sautéed zucchini and a small amount of sharp cheese to keep the calories low while maximizing fiber.
instructions: Sauté zucchini in a pan until soft. Place on half of each tortilla, top with cheese, fold, and grill until crisp.

recipes.title: Spicy Mango Ceviche (Vegan)
recipes.description: A vibrant fruit-based ceviche. Diced mango is 'cured' in lime and chili for a fat-free and refreshing vegan appetizer.
instructions: Toss diced mango with lime and chili. Chill for 10 minutes and serve with cucumber slices.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken Burrito Bowl
recipes.description: A complete and balanced meal in a bowl. Featuring lean grilled chicken, fiber-rich black beans, and brown rice with a zesty lime dressing.
instructions: Assemble bowls with rice, beans, and grilled chicken. Top with fresh salsa and a dollop of Greek yogurt.

recipes.title: Healthy Enchilada Skillet
recipes.description: All the flavor of enchiladas without the rolling and extra fat. Lean turkey and beans are simmered in a red chili sauce with whole wheat tortilla strips.
instructions: Brown the turkey. Add sauce and tortilla strips. Simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce has thickened slightly.

recipes.title: Mexican Fruit Cup with Tajin
recipes.description: The quintessential Mexican street snack. A variety of fresh tropical fruits are seasoned with lime juice and a salty-spicy chili blend.
instructions: Toss fruit cubes with lime juice and sprinkle with Tajin. Serve immediately while fresh and cold.
